name: @arena/runtime-host-service
description: Arena durable host runtime core (Work Order P002; issue #154; ADR-P001-01/02/07). The REAL implementation of @arena/runtime-host's frozen RuntimeHostApi: the durable port set over the Neon/Postgres adapter surface (one shared SqlTransport, versioned migrations 0001-0005, the named durable-runtime statement set), host lifecycle/health/readiness, the registered host job kinds with host-side claiming semantics (lease stamp -> execute -> complete/fail; expired-lease reclaim at start; dead-letter lot), tenant-gated + lens-stamped escalation surfaces, recorded outcomes for deterministic replay, and the restart-recovery sweep. The composed SERVICE engines (services/escalation-api, services/job-orchestrator) are INJECTED through the frozen package's structural surfaces (boundary law B2: a service never imports another service) and are wired at the composition site (deploy/runtime/src/composition.ts — the M1-designated wiring point; tests/runtime-host pins the real-class parity). The nested adapters/hosted/neon-postgres adapter is composed through tsconfig/vitest path aliases (the TL-flagged nested-adapter glob-gap precedent from deploy/src/hosted); for the same reason the package build is tsc --noEmit (the deploy/src/hosted precedent — an emitted dist would pull adapter sources outside rootDir). @electric-sql/pglite is the tests/runtime-host battery's embedded real-Postgres engine pin, owned here because tests/* is not a pnpm workspace project (the P004 @aws-sdk-in-adapters/hosted pin-ownership precedent).
